title: Push–pull electronic effects of a three-component two-heterojunction electrocatalyst for directional carrier transport in bifunctional water electrolysis
content:
Sustainable Energy Fuels, 2026, 10,2515-2523
DOI: 10.1039/D6SE00237D, Paper
Ankit Sharma, Nitul Kalita, Mohammad Qureshi
A hierarchical Ni3(PO4)2/NiCo2S4/NiCo(OH)2 heterostructure based on a “push–pull” mechanism, with dual n–n–p heterojunction, drives directional carrier transport to accelerate OER/HER kinetics, delivering superior bifunctional performance.
